title: 008 紫衣侯
content_zh:
“听风辨位，障目杀人。”身出孤虚之外的黑袍人首领冷笑一声，“若是以为这样就能破了孤虚之阵，那也太天真了。”他从怀里掏出了一管笛子，随即一首清冷凄厉的曲子便响了起来，在这清冷的夜里，显得分外诡异。
孤虚阵中的二人也同时听到了这首曲子。唐莲不由皱紧了眉头。
雷无桀只觉一瞬间，那刚才感觉平和舒缓的风忽然也变得凄厉起来了，可却不像是有人撕裂了那阵风，可正当他犹豫间，几道攻势却已经向他袭来。虽然在片刻间他已经反应过来一一挡了回去，却依旧还是挂了彩。
“凝神！”唐莲怒吼道，声音洪亮无比，尽带着佛门狮吼功的功力。
那笛声随着这一声怒吼竟然一滞，雷无桀也喘过一口气息来，将突然袭来的一只鬼爪一拳打了回去。
唐莲笑道：“虽然这的确是孤虚之阵，但跟三师公与我所说的他当年所遇的孤虚阵相比，却还是相差了太远。据说当年魔教东征，在祁连山下所布的孤虚之阵覆盖足足有百里之大，其中鬼魅百现，如人间地狱。而当时三师公的年纪也不过比现在的我大了三岁，三师公能破那般奇阵，这小小的孤虚阵，我要是败下阵来，也是愧对雪月城这多年的教导了。”
“师兄有破阵之法？”雷无桀喜道。
唐莲足尖一点，已掠到了雷无桀的身后，两人双背相抵，互相守住了彼此后方的空门。二人在孤虚阵中，犹如瞎子一般，攻势从四面八方随时而来，而这样一来却减少了许多偷袭。
“师兄厉害！”
“这是常识！”唐莲斥道，“孤虚之阵破解之法在于布阵之人，我现在需要找出这个人。只要找出了这个人，将他击退，阵法自然随时可破。”
“可是我们现在身处孤虚之中，如何能找到他呢？”雷无桀问道。
唐莲微微一笑：“笛声。他不该吹笛子的，布阵之人应该保证绝对的隐蔽，但是他心急了。你来为我掠阵！”
“得命！”雷无桀大声应道，双拳一挥，将那些试图迫近的黑袍人全都打了出去，但同时他的呼吸声也变得越来越重，他明白以自己现在的体力最多还能撑一百招，而百招之后如果唐莲还未破阵，只怕自己得力竭而死了。
唐莲此时紧闭着的眼睛，他听风辨位的功夫最多稍逊于唐老太爷、唐门三老这样的顶级暗器高手，只是得了片刻的喘息，便寻觅到了笛声的踪迹，他的心神顺着笛声逆风而去，终于寻觅到了那个吹笛的黑袍人，此时他正坐在不远处的一颗枯树上。
“就是那儿了！”唐莲眼睛猛地睁开，手中一朵佛怒唐莲破空而出，随着那朵佛怒唐莲的破空而出，孤虚之阵像是被撕裂开来了一样，周围正常的场景一点点显现出来。
站在枯树之上的黑袍老人放下了手中的笛子，他看着那朵妖冶鬼魅的七瓣莲花冲着自己急飞而来，急忙一跃而下。但是那朵莲花在空中忽然炸裂了开来，七瓣莲花冲着七个不同的方向散射出去，其中有一瓣就那样直接贯穿了老人的胸膛，鲜血顿时汹涌而出，老人重重地摔在了地上。
“阵破了。”雷无桀喜道。
“是的。阵破了。”回答他的却是一个陌生的声音。
雷无桀大惊，唐莲也惊出一身冷汗，不知何时，在唐莲和雷无桀之间竟站着一个紫衣长袍之人，他手中拿着一把折扇，嘴角微微含笑。
“你！”唐莲猛地转身，紫衣人手中折扇却猛地一转，一把将唐莲击飞了出去，唐莲重重地摔在了地上，吐出了一口鲜血。

紫衣人转身问那些黑袍人：“白发去哪里了，按照约定此时他此时早已得手才对。他不在，以你们这些人，怎是唐莲的对手。”
“你卑鄙！”雷无桀咬牙骂道。
“哦？”紫衣人转回身看他，“你又是何人？为何说本侯卑鄙？”
“你趁人不备，怎不卑鄙？”雷无桀怒道。
紫衣人轻笑一声：“难道我还应大喊一声，唐莲我来杀你了，然后彼此鞠躬之后再拔剑相向吗？”
雷无桀气急，骂道：“你们本就以多欺少，再加上我师兄刚破孤虚之阵，心神未定，你暗施冷箭，又怎不卑鄙？”
“你怕是搞错了。我们不是来比武的。我们是来杀人的。”紫衣人目光忽然一凛，手中折扇一挥，就向雷无桀袭来。
雷无桀一拳迎上，却觉得虽然紫衣人只是轻轻一挥，但折扇上的力道却似有千斤之般，他的拳素以霸道为主，却被他那折扇击得往后猛退。
“火灼之术，燃烧内心薪柴，获得短暂神力。我还以为雷轰之后，霹雳堂已经没人会这门武功了。你很好。”紫衣人一边说着，手中折扇一边挥舞，将雷无桀迫得往后节节退去，“可惜经历刚刚的孤虚之阵后，你早已是强弩之末。”
紫衣人停住了身，仰天一叹，折扇往空中一挥，竟将雷无桀整个人也击飞了出去。雷无桀只觉那折扇一挥之下，有一股内力如排山倒海之势而来，他觉得整个人被这股气息压得透不过气来，心中那一股灼热之气也在瞬间崩溃，他重重地落地之后，原本变得火红的瞳孔也黯淡了下来。
“当年雷轰祭起七重火灼之术时尚且只能勉强抗住本侯的紫气东来，又何况你呢？”紫衣人摇头叹息，转身竟欲离去。
“你不杀我？”雷无桀本已做好拼死一搏的机会。
紫衣人停下了脚步：“即便我有心放你，这些人想必为了你身后的棺材也绝不会放你。不过倘若你能够活下来，那么有朝一日，我还你公平的一战。”
“我师父将我赶出门，我初时不解。直到昨日我见到了一柄刀，今日见了你的扇，方知师父所说的‘天地偌大’。”雷无桀双拳紧握，运起内力，瞳孔再次被点燃成了火红色，一身红色长衫无风自舞，“然而，见天地偌大还不够，我也想，成为这天地。”
“倒是个有趣的小子。”紫衣人笑了笑，看了那群黑袍人一眼，“你们可要小心了。”
“尊上，这二人非同小可，还是早些料理了的好，以免留下后患。”一个黑袍垂首劝说。
“杀两个重伤的人，你们做不到吗？白发调教出的属下，真是一群废物。把棺材拿到手，我去寻白发。”紫衣人没有再说话，足尖微微一点，几个起落，身影便已消失不见。
“倒是个有趣的人。”唐莲此时终于勉强站了起来，“如果此时他留下来，我们没有胜算。”
“你的意思是现在你们有胜算？”一名黑袍人冷笑一声。
唐莲走上前拍了拍雷无桀的肩膀：“杀你们几个杂碎，有什么难的。”唐莲虽装作一副坦然自若的样子，但雷无桀知道，唐莲与其说是拍他的肩膀，不如说是勉强扶着自己的肩膀才不至摔倒。

“师兄……”雷无桀正欲回身扶他，却被唐莲止住了：“蕊刚刚收到了讯号，接头人已在城外，她如今已去接应。我们此刻必须拖住这些人，等到他们回来！”
“好。”雷无桀点点头，随即大喝一声：“你们一起上吧。”
“一起上？”黑袍人伸出了他那只惨白的手，“你是不是以为这样的虚张声势能吓退我们？可既然你说一起上，那我们便如你所愿！上！”
一瞬间，十几个人，同时攻向了他们。不，他们同时攻向的，只有唐莲！
唐莲咬牙道：“他们看穿了我的伤势。”
“没有人比我们更了解紫衣侯的掌力，中了那一掌，你必定身受重伤！”
然而此时一个人挡在了唐莲的面前，他当然是雷无桀，但是此时的雷无桀，也只是凭借着最后一口真气强撑的，随时都会倒下。十几道掌力同时击在了他的身上，他怒喝一声，双瞳变得赤红。
“退！”为首的黑袍人急忙下令。
但已经来不及了，只是一个瞬间，十几个人同时被雷无桀震飞了出去，重重地摔在了地上。雷无桀也膝盖一软，整个人跪在了地上，他摇头叹息：“早知道当年和师父学武时，少偷点懒了。”
“还没有到可以放松的时候。”唐莲叹了口气，抬头看到那些黑袍人一个个又站了起来，虽然一个个身上都挂了彩，但伤势却并不严重。
雷无桀苦笑：“我现在已经是一点力气都没有了。”
唐莲也叹气：“那紫衣人的掌力着实厉害，我到现在也无法运起真气。”
为首的黑袍人冷笑：“看来二位的命，今晚却要留在这里了。”
“留不留在这里，却也不是你能说的算的。”一个懒洋洋地声音打断了他，雷无桀惊喜地回头，唤道：“萧瑟！”
却只见一个身穿狐裘的身影稳稳地落在了黄金棺材之上，说完后更是懒洋洋地打了个哈欠，不是萧瑟却又是谁？
content_en:
"Listen to the wind to identify the position, blind the eyes to kill." The leader of the men in black robes who was outside Guxu sneered, "If you think you can break Guxu's formation, you are too naive." He took out a flute from his arms, and then a cold and sad song played, which seemed particularly strange in this cold night.
The two people in the Guxu Formation also heard this song at the same time. Tang Lian couldn't help but frown.
Lei Wujie felt that for a moment, the wind that had just felt peaceful and soothing suddenly became shrill and shrill, but it didn't look like someone had torn the gust of wind apart. But just as he was hesitating, several attacks had already hit him. Although he had reacted in a moment and blocked them one by one, he still failed.
"Concentrate!" Tang Lian roared angrily, her voice extremely loud and full of the power of the Buddhist Lion's Roar Technique.
The sound of the flute stopped with this roar, and Lei Wujie took a breath and punched back a ghost claw that suddenly attacked.
Tang Lian smiled and said: "Although this is indeed the Guxu Formation, it is still far behind the Guxu Formation that the Third Master told me he encountered back then. It is said that during the Demon Sect's Eastern Expedition, the Guxu Formation deployed at the foot of the Qilian Mountains covered an area of a hundred miles. , there are so many ghosts and ghosts in it, it’s like hell on earth. And the third master was only three years older than me now. The third master could break such a strange formation. If I were to lose this small Guxu Formation, I would be ashamed of all my years of teaching from Xue Yue City.”
"Senior brother, do you have a way to break the formation?" Lei Wujie said happily.
Tang Lian's tiptoes reached behind Lei Wujie. The two of them pressed their backs against each other, guarding the empty door behind each other. The two of them were like blind men in the Guxu Formation, with attacks coming from all directions at any time, but this reduced many sneak attacks.
"Senior brother is amazing!"
"This is common sense!" Tang Lian scolded, "The way to break Guxu's formation lies in the person who set it up. I need to find this person now. As long as I find this person and repel him, the formation can be broken at any time."
"But we are now alone, how can we find him?" Lei Wujie asked.
Tang Lian smiled slightly: "The sound of the flute. He shouldn't be playing the flute. The person setting up the formation should ensure absolute concealment, but he is impatient. Come and plunder the formation for me!"
"Death!" Lei Wujie responded loudly, swinging his fists and knocking out all the men in black robes who tried to approach, but at the same time his breathing became heavier and heavier. He knew that with his current physical strength, he could only sustain a hundred moves at most, and if Tang Lian had not broken the formation after a hundred moves, he would probably die of exhaustion.
Tang Lian's eyes were tightly closed at this time. His ability to identify the position by listening to the wind was at most slightly inferior to top hidden weapon masters such as Old Man Tang and the Three Elders of the Tang Sect. After only a moment of breathing, he found the trace of the sound of the flute. His mind followed the sound of the flute and went against the wind, and finally found the man in black robes playing the flute. At this time, he was sitting on a dead tree not far away.
"That's it!" Tang Lian's eyes suddenly opened, and a Buddha's Angry Tang Lotus burst out of the air. As the Buddha's Angry Tang Lotus burst out of the air, the Guxu Formation seemed to be torn apart, and the normal scenes around him appeared bit by bit.
The old man in black robe standing on the dead tree put down the flute in his hand. He watched the enchanting and ghostly seven-petal lotus flying towards him and jumped down in a hurry. But the lotus suddenly exploded in the air, and the seven-petal lotus scattered in seven different directions. One of them penetrated directly through the old man's chest. Blood suddenly surged out, and the old man fell heavily to the ground.
"The formation is broken." Lei Wujie said happily.
"Yes. The formation is broken." He was answered by a strange voice.
Lei Wujie was shocked, and Tang Lian also broke out in a cold sweat. At some point, a man in purple robes stood between Tang Lian and Lei Wujie. He was holding a folding fan in his hand and mouth.Jiao smiled slightly.
"You!" Tang Lian suddenly turned around, but the folding fan in the purple man's hand suddenly turned and knocked Tang Lian away. Tang Lian fell heavily to the ground and spit out a mouthful of blood.
The man in purple turned around and asked the men in black: "Where did Baifa go? According to the agreement, he had already succeeded at this time. If he is not here, how can you be Tang Lian's opponent?"
"You are despicable!" Lei Wujie cursed through gritted teeth.
"Oh?" The man in purple turned back to look at him, "Who are you? Why do you say I am despicable?"
"How can you not be mean if you take advantage of others?" Lei Wujie said angrily.
The man in purple chuckled lightly: "Should I still shout, Tang Lian, I'm here to kill you, and then bow to each other before drawing swords at each other?"
Lei Wujie was furious and cursed: "You are already bullying the minority with more, and my senior brother has just broken through Guxu's formation and is still undecided. How can you not be despicable when you secretly attack with cold arrows?"
"I'm afraid you're mistaken. We're not here to compete. We're here to kill people." The man in purple suddenly had a sharp look in his eyes, and with a wave of the folding fan in his hand, he attacked Lei Wujie.
Lei Wujie met him with a punch, but he felt that although the man in purple only swung lightly, the force on the folding fan seemed to be as strong as a thousand pounds. His fists were usually domineering, but he was pushed back by his folding fan.
"The art of burning fire burns the firewood in the heart and gains short-term divine power. I thought that after the thunder, no one in Pili Hall knew this martial art. You are very good." The man in purple said, waving the folding fan in his hand, forcing Lei Wujie to retreat. "It's a pity that after the Guxu Formation just now, you are already at the end of your strength."
The man in purple stopped, looked up to the sky and sighed, then waved his folding fan into the air, knocking Lei Wujie flying out. Lei Wujie felt that with a wave of the folding fan, there was an overwhelming amount of internal energy. He felt that his whole body was suffocated by this aura, and the burning energy in his heart also collapsed in an instant. After he landed heavily, his originally fiery red pupils also dimmed.
"Back then, Lei Hong sacrificed the seventh-level fire technique in a fashionable manner and could barely withstand my Lord's purple energy coming from the east. How about you?" The man in purple shook his head and sighed, turned around and wanted to leave.
"You won't kill me?" Lei Wujie was already prepared for the chance to fight to the death.
The man in purple stopped and said, "Even if I want to let you go, these people will never let you go because of the coffin behind you. But if you can survive, then one day I will give you a fair fight."
"My master kicked me out. I didn't understand it at first. It wasn't until I saw a knife yesterday and your fan today that I realized what the master said about 'the world is so big.'" Lei Wujie clenched his fists and channeled his inner strength. His pupils were ignited into fiery red again. He wore a red gown and danced in the wind. "However, seeing how big the world is is not enough. I also want to become this world."
"He is an interesting boy." The man in purple smiled and glanced at the group of men in black robes, "You should be careful."
"Your Majesty, these two people are not trivial. It's better to take care of them earlier to avoid any future troubles." A man in black robe lowered his head to persuade.
"You can't kill two seriously injured people, can't you? The subordinates trained by Bai Fa are really a bunch of trash. Get the coffin and I'll go find Bai Fa." The man in purple didn't speak any more. He tiptoed slightly, raised and lowered a few times, and then the figure disappeared.
"He is an interesting person." Tang Lian finally stood up reluctantly, "If he stays here at this time, we have no chance of winning."
"You mean you have a chance of winning now?" A man in black robe sneered.
Tang Lian stepped forward and patted Lei Wujie on the shoulder: "It's not hard to kill you bastards." Although Tang Lian pretended to be calm and composed, Lei Wujie knew that Tang Lian was not so much patting his shoulder as he was holding on to his own shoulder to prevent him from falling.
"Senior brother..." Lei Wujie was about to turn around and help himHe was stopped by Tang Lian: "Rui just received the signal. The contact person is already outside the city. She has now gone to respond. We must hold these people at this moment until they come back!"
"Okay." Lei Wujie nodded, and then shouted: "You all come together."
"Come together?" The man in black robe stretched out his pale hand, "Do you think such bluff can scare us away? But since you said we will come together, then we will do as you wish! Come on!"
In an instant, more than a dozen people attacked them at the same time. No, the only one they attacked at the same time was Tang Lian!
Tang Lian gritted her teeth and said, "They saw through my injuries."
"No one knows the power of Zi Yihou's palm better than us. If you get hit by that palm, you will definitely be seriously injured!"
However, at this time, a person stood in front of Tang Lian. He was of course Lei Wujie, but at this time, Lei Wujie was only holding on with his last breath of true energy and would fall down at any time. More than a dozen palms hit him at the same time, and he roared angrily, his pupils turning red.
"Retreat!" the leader of the black-robed man ordered hurriedly.
But it was too late. In just a moment, more than a dozen people were thrown away by Lei Wujie at the same time and fell heavily to the ground. Lei Wujie's knees also weakened and he knelt on the ground. He shook his head and sighed: "I wish I would have been less lazy when I was learning martial arts with my master."
"It's not time to relax yet." Tang Lian sighed and looked up to see the men in black robes standing up again. Although they were all covered in injuries, their injuries were not serious.
Lei Wujie smiled bitterly: "I have no strength at all now."
Tang Lian also sighed: "The palm power of the man in purple is really powerful, and I still can't bring up my true energy."
The leader of the men in black robes sneered: "It seems that your lives will depend on staying here tonight."
"Whether you want to stay here or not is not up to you." A lazy voice interrupted him. Lei Wujie turned around in surprise and called out: "Xiao Se!"
But he saw a figure in fox fur landing steadily on the golden coffin. After finishing speaking, he yawned lazily. If it wasn't Xiao Se, who could it be?
